title: Im trying to make a rain effect with the show picture and move picture command with a 640×480 screen resolution...

posts.author: socon
posts.body:
Can you help me figure out with the parameters that I should use?
Been trying to figure this out for a few days thanks

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Probably better to use a weather script. I can't imagine running that continuously with a common event and not lag the game. You'd have to rapidly show and erase rain drop images with various starting and ending points. Moghunter has a weather script in his vx ace master folder:
https://mogplugins.wordpress.com/rpg-maker-vx-ace/
